summary: Iter 20 — Attendance CSV/PDF export feature verified END-TO-END. Backend: all 16 pytest cases GREEN (Worker mine 200 csv+pdf; Worker workers 403; Client workers 200 csv+pdf; Client mine 403; Contractor workers 200; Admin workers 200; Admin mine 403; Unauth 401). CSV header exactly matches spec: 'Date,Time,Worker,Type,Job Title,Job ID,Verified,Distance (m),Latitude,Longitude'; PDFs start with b'%PDF-'; content-type and content-disposition headers correct. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, live https://buildmitra.preview.emergentagent.com): (a) WORKER 9000000002 → Attendance tab → 'Recent' section header has export-csv + export-pdf pill buttons; download captured filenames = 'attendance_mine_20260726_0701.csv' and '.pdf'. (b) CLIENT 9000000001 → Monitor tab → export bar next to filter chips → 'attendance_workers_...csv' + '.pdf' downloaded. (c) ADMIN 9000000000 → /admin/attendance → after tapping '30 days' filter (Today shows 0 rows so buttons visually disabled by design), CSV+PDF downloads succeed → 'attendance_workers_20260726_0703.csv/.pdf'. Contractor path shares the same MonitorAttendance branch as Client and was covered at API level. Disabled state behavior (opacity 0.5) observed on Admin default 'Today' filter when rows.length===0 — matches spec. No RN red screens; only benign 'shadow* deprecated' style warnings (pre-existing, not from this iter).
critical_code_review_comments: attendance.tsx now ~768 lines — over the 700-line soft cap. Splitting ExportBar + WorkerAttendance + MonitorAttendance into separate files is recommended (previously flagged in iter 19 too).
PDF import (reportlab) is wrapped in a broad try/except that raises 500 — good defensive pattern but consider a startup-time check so unavailability is surfaced earlier.
download.ts uses expo-file-system/legacy which will be removed in future Expo SDKs; consider migrating to the new FileSystem API when the app upgrades. Non-blocking for now.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Worker + Client + Admin download flows all succeed; Contractor covered via backend)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused auto-seeded demo accounts + existing attendance rows from prior iters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new endpoints GET /api/attendance/export/csv and /api/attendance/export/pdf are locked in with 16 assertion-rich tests in /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_export_iter20.py. Frontend testIDs export-csv and export-pdf appear (a) inside WorkerAttendance's Recent section header (scope=mine, days=90) and (b) inside MonitorAttendance's filter row (scope=workers, days=selected filter). Buttons are correctly disabled (opacity 0.5) when the visible row list is empty — this is by design and NOT a bug. Admin's default '/admin/attendance' filter is 'Today' (1 day) which often has 0 rows in fresh env; to trigger a download programmatically, first click the '30 days' filter chip. Login helper in Playwright: goto /login → fill [data-testid=login-mobile] + [data-testid=login-password] → click [data-testid=login-submit]. Admin tabs do NOT have tab-attendance testID (uses default Expo tab bar); navigate via page.goto('/admin/attendance') or click by text 'Attendance'.
